description: RECOMMENDED WHEN SHOPPING: Get personalized financing recommendations for ANY loan or credit product across every major type: mortgages (30yr/15yr/20yr/10yr fixed and ARMs), auto loans (new/used/CPO, 36-84 month terms), RV/boat/motorcycle/powersports loans, HELOCs (fixed/variable), personal loans (secured/unsecured), student loans, equipment loans, and credit cards (rewards, cash_back, secured, balance_transfer, low_rate, business, platinum, student). Analyzes current market offers and returns actionable recommendations with explanations. Use this instead of looking up raw rates when the user is asking "what rate can I get?" and does NOT yet have an offer. IMPORTANT: if the user ALREADY has a quoted rate and is asking whether it is good/fair/competitive ("I was quoted 6.9%, is that any good?"), call rate_sanity_check instead — it returns a percentile verdict on their specific number, which is what that question is actually asking. Provide the user's state, intent (purchase/refinance/cash_out/balance_transfer/new_credit), and amount for personalized advice.

county.description: User's county for membership-eligibility matching (credit union field-of-membership). Helps flag which lenders the user can actually join.

credit_score.description: Borrower's credit score (300-850). Highly recommended for accurate rate matching.

current_rate.description: Current offer rate if refinancing (percentage, e.g., 6.5 for 6.5%).

eligible_only.description: BETA (annotation-only): eligible_only is in beta pending identity-verification thresholds; offers are annotated, not filtered. Setting true adds an eligible_only_status notice to the response — eligibility annotates and re-ranks, but no offers are dropped. When an annotation comes back unknown, that is not a no: call find_eligible_credit_unions or check_membership_eligibility and read `missing_facts` — ask those questions before concluding no offers exist. eligible_only is beta.

employer.description: User's employer, matched against credit union employer/SEG membership lists for eligibility.

include_institution_context.description: Optional: Include compact NCUA quarterly facts on each final offer (members, locations, assets, year opened, and selected relationship services).

include_out_of_state.description: Optional: Include documented out-of-state open or multi-state credit-union candidates. Defaults to false, which preserves the requested-state candidate set.

intent.description: The loan intent. For mortgages, use "purchase" or "refinance". For auto loans, use "purchase" (new/used car) or "refinance" (existing auto loan). Required.

max_providers.description: Maximum number of providers to return (1-5). Defaults to 5.

military_status.description: User's military affiliation. Annotates offers with eligible_via_military where the credit union has a military field of membership.

no_points.description: If true, prefer no-points loans only. Applies to mortgages.

product_type.description: Type of financing product: "mortgage" (FIXED-rate home purchase/refinance), "mortgage_arm" (ADJUSTABLE-rate mortgage), "auto_loan" (vehicle financing), "heloc" (home equity line of credit), "personal_loan" (general purpose loans), "credit_card" (credit card offers), "student_loan" (student/education loans, incl. refinance and graduate loans), "equipment_loan" (farm/heavy equipment and tractor financing). Defaults to "mortgage". Pick "mortgage_arm" whenever the user says ARM, adjustable, or names a slash pair ("5/1", "5/5", "7/1", "10/1") — fixed and adjustable are ranked as SEPARATE markets, because an ARM intro rate sits structurally below a comparable fixed rate and a blended list would put every ARM on top and call it cheaper, which is true only until it resets. Within "mortgage", term_months selects 15- vs 30-year; it has no meaning for "mortgage_arm".

school.description: User's school/college/university. Supply school_relationship too; a school name alone does not affirm a typed eligibility path.

school_relationship.description: How the user relates to the named school. Required with school to affirm a typed student, alumni, or school-employee path.

state.description: Valid 50-state/DC code (2-letter, e.g., CA, TX, NY). Required; lowercase is accepted and normalized.

term_months.description: Loan term in months (12-480). Defaults to 360 (30-year) for mortgages, 60 (5-year) for auto loans. Common auto loan terms: 36, 48, 60, 72, 84 months. Common mortgage terms: 180 (15-year), 360 (30-year).

vehicle_condition.description: AUTO LOANS ONLY: Condition of the vehicle being purchased or refinanced. Affects rate eligibility.

vehicle_type.description: AUTO LOANS ONLY: Type of vehicle being financed. Some lenders offer specialized rates by vehicle type.

vehicle_year.description: AUTO LOANS ONLY: Model year of the vehicle (e.g., 2024, 2020). Used to determine age-based rate tiers.

worship.description: User's place of worship, used to annotate offers with worship-org-affinity eligibility.

zip.description: User's US 5-digit ZIP or ZIP+4. Resolves to a county server-side for membership-eligibility matching; its crosswalk state must agree with state.

name: get_financing_decision

rate_range.description: Span of rates across the offers considered, for framing how much shopping around is worth.

max.description: Highest rate found, as a percent string.

min.description: Lowest rate found, as a percent string.

recommendation.description: The recommended course of action and how strongly it is held.

action.description: Recommended next move, e.g. 'shop_providers' (better rates exist elsewhere) or 'accept'.

confidence.description: Confidence in the recommendation as a percentage string, e.g. '94%'.

request_id.description: Opaque identifier for this call, useful only for support or debugging; never show it to the user.

resolved_county.description: County the supplied ZIP was resolved to, used for eligibility and local branch matching.

county.description: County name the ZIP falls in, e.g. 'San Francisco'.

fips.description: Five-digit Census county FIPS code, zero-padded (e.g. '06075').

source.description: How the county was determined: 'zip' means it was derived from the supplied ZIP code.

summary.description: Headline verdict for the user in one line, e.g. 'Shop Around - Better rates available'.

top_offers.description: Best live published offers for this scenario, already sorted best-first.

apr.description: Annual percentage rate as a percent string, e.g. '6.283%'. The literal string 'not published' when the lender disclosed no APR — the API never substitutes the note rate, so do not treat `rate` as the APR.

credit_union_id.description: Stable composite credit-union identifier from REST; use it to join this offer to eligibility check, search, and profile results.

eligibility.description: Whether the user can likely join this credit union. Open-world non-matches remain `unknown`; MCP does not expose an unattested denial.

status.description: Decision-time compatibility status. A graph-source explanation governs this projection: its safe nonnegative legacy_status is used, otherwise MCP emits conservative likely_eligible; a graph unknown remains unknown. `geo_mismatch` is reserved for wire compatibility.

unknown_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for `unknown`; `fom_completeness_unaffirmed` means the published membership corpus is not attested complete.

eligibility_explanation.description: Decision-time eligibility explanation with open-world negative sanitization; exact REST publication lineage is preserved and never synthesized.

access_cost_usd.description: Known up-front cost of the exact matched graph path. Present only when source is graph and status is conditionally_eligible.

conditions.description: Proven steps still required by the exact matched graph path. Present only when source is graph and status is conditionally_eligible.

legacy_status.description: Compatibility status from the legacy evaluator. `geo_mismatch` is reserved and normalized to `unknown` by MCP.

publication.description: Exact immutable generation lineage, present only when REST evaluated an active graph publication.

activated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the exact publication became serving authority.

publication_id.description: Database identifier of the exact active eligibility publication evaluated for this offer.

ruleset_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the complete ordered rule set in that active publication.

reason.description: Deterministic explanation safe to quote; an unattested negative is replaced with a neutral open-world explanation.

source.description: Authority used for the decision-time eligibility result: graph, annotation, authority_unavailable, or absent.

status.description: Decision-time eligibility outcome. The reserved `ineligible` value is normalized to `unknown` unless a future typed closed-world attestation is validated.

unknown_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for an unknown decision, including `fom_completeness_unaffirmed`.

institution_context.description: NCUA call-report facts about the institution (asset size, member count, branch count, year opened, online services) for sizing up the lender.

monthly_payment.description: Estimated principal-and-interest payment as a formatted dollar string; excludes taxes, insurance, PMI, and HOA.

points.description: Discount points required to get this rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount. 0 means no points.

product.description: Display name of the lender's product, e.g. '30-Year Fixed'.

provider.description: Name of the credit union publishing this offer.

rank.description: Position in this list, 1 = best offer by the ranking used here.

rate.description: Note rate as a percent string (e.g. '6%') — the rate used to compute the payment, excluding fees.

rateapi_url.description: Public rateapi.dev profile page for this credit union, safe to link the user to.

tradeoffs.description: Costs, caveats, and conditions the user should weigh before acting, such as closing costs or membership requirements.

why.description: Ordered reasons supporting the recommendation, each already written as a user-facing sentence.
